contradictions: Published activation rates disagree on the central figure: usetandem.ai gives a 41.7% median with quartiles at 71% and 19%, and also reports a 37.5% average. A median and an average of a skewed distribution are not the same statistic, and neither source states which products entered the sample. Both appear on this page rather than one being chosen.
